items.title: Adani Green Q2 Results: Profit rises 15% YoY to Rs 673 crore; revenue jumps 39%
items.description: Adani Green Energy reported a 15% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 673 crore in Q2, while revenue grew 39% to Rs 4,520 crore. Power supply revenue rose 45% to Rs 4,019 crore, and energy sales increased 33% to 12,090 million units, reflecting expanding operational capacity.

items.title: Mahindra Finance Q2 net profit surges 55% to Rs 882 crore on volumes, lower credit cost
items.description: Business assets under management grew 15% year on year to Rs 1.47 lakh crore. Non-vehicle finance disbursements, including SME loans, personal loans and housing finance, increased 52%.

items.title: PC Jewellers Q2 Results: Net profit shoots up 58% to Rs 331 crore; company says it is now debt-free
items.description: PC Jewellers Ltd has achieved an impressive 58 percent growth in net profit for Q2 of the 2026-27 fiscal year, driven by sales that surged beyond Rs 1,054 crore. The company is now debt-free after early repayment to banks and is set to unveil a new jewellery brand aimed at attracting younger consumers.

items.title: IHCL Q2 Results: Tata Group-owned hotel chain's net profit jumps 19% to Rs 379 crore
items.description: Indian Hotels Company Ltd, under the Tata Group, has announced a remarkable 19.35% rise in consolidated profit for the September quarter, soaring to Rs 379.85 crore from Rs 318.26 crore last year. Revenue from operations also surged to Rs 2,484.32 crore, up from Rs 2,040.89 crore. The Managing Director highlighted promising growth prospects and anticipates domestic hotel business growth exceeding 20%, notwithstanding challenges faced in the aviation sector.

items.title: IGI Q2 Results: Consolidated PAT surges 43% to Rs 185 crore
items.description: The International Gemological Institute recently announced an impressive 43.14 percent growth in profit after tax for the previous quarter. Operational revenue rose by 31 percent compared to last year. Demand for both lab-grown and natural diamonds remains strong, particularly as the festive season approaches, prompting retailers and manufacturers to anticipate a surge in sales across their segments.

items.title: Aye Finance Q2 Results: Net profit more than doubles to Rs 87 crore
items.description: Aye Finance Ltd's net profit surged to Rs 87 crore in the second quarter of the financial year, a remarkable increase from Rs 35 crore in the same timeframe last year. Total income also climbed to Rs 527 crore, reflecting an 18.42% year-over-year growth. The interest income saw a rise to Rs 479 crore, while assets under management swelled by 26% to hit Rs 7,597 crore as of September 2026.

items.title: Eternal Q2 Results: Profit soars 92% YoY to Rs 125 crore; revenue zooms 78%
items.description: Eternal Q2 Results: Eternal, the parent company of Zomato and Blinkit, reported a 92.3% year-on-year (YoY) jump in net profit to Rs 125 crore in the second quarter of FY27 (Q2FY27), compared with Rs 65 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year.
